Name: DexCom Inc
Description: DexCom, Inc. is a leading innovator in diabetes care, specializing in the development, manufacture, and distribution of advanced continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) systems designed to improve diabetes management for patients globally. Headquartered in San Diego, California, with a strategic manufacturing facility in Mesa, Arizona, the company is committed to enhancing the quality of life for those with diabetes through its cutting-edge technology. As a pioneer in glucose monitoring solutions, DexCom continues to expand its footprint internationally, solidifying its position in the healthcare industry and addressing the growing demand for effective diabetes management tools.
Address: 6340 SEQUENCE DRIVE, SAN DIEGO, CA, UNITED STATES, 92121
